tagline: Trusted local STIHL experts in Howick
heroSubheading: Complete outdoor power equipment and expert servicing for your home or business.
aboutHtml:
We're Garth and Tessa, owners of STIHL SHOP Howick. We opened in December 2020, and as long-time East Auckland residents, we're committed to supporting our community from homeowners and contractors to schools and businesses.

We stock a complete range of outdoor power equipment including STIHL, Masport, Honda, Cub Cadet, Rover, Ziegler & Brown, Pope, Culleys and Green Gorilla. Everything in our bright, modern store arrives fully assembled and ready to go. We provide sales, servicing, repairs, key cutting and battery drop-off. Our STIHL trained technicians handle all makes and models with quick, expert service.

When your tools are in our workshop, you can borrow battery-powered equipment to try at home. Come see us seven days a week, and we'll help you find the right tool for the job.
